name: CivitAI Guy
source:
CivitAI Guy is a modern visual novel with a management layer—built as an experiment in true community-driven development. Plan your days and nights, earn and spend, unlock upgrades that meaningfully change how you play, and build relationships that branch into unique events and payoffs.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/civitai]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
CivitAI Guy是一部带有管理层的现代视觉小说——作为真正社区驱动开发的实验而构建。规划你的日日夜夜、赚取和支出、解锁可显着改变你游戏方式的升级，并建立可拓展到独特活动和回报的关系。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/civitai]Patreon[/url]]
